name: Eufornis Minor
description: Eufornis Minor, sometimes referred to as simply Eufornis, was a planet located in the Shadola sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A remote colony, it was sometimes confused with Eufornis Major, a prestigious city-planet located within the Core Worlds.
